title: Low-side MOSFET switch
summary: Logic-level N-MOSFET switching a load to ground: gate resistor, gate pull-down, and a flyback diode for motors, relays and solenoids.

ports.VLOAD: load supply (the flyback diode returns here)

notes: The pull-down keeps the load off while the microcontroller pin is still floating at power-up.
AO3400A is fully on at 2.5 V gate drive (about 5 A, 30 V). Check the load current against the FET you fit.
The diode is only needed for inductive loads but does no harm otherwise.
